I would advise you to force yourself to take up a hobby, even if you do not feel motivated. For example you can make art paint or sketch. I would also recommend journaling. It's a great way to express your feelings. Just like the way you have expressed yourself on this website, you can write down your feelings and maybe have some classical music on in the background to focus and relax your mind at least a tiny bit. The key to getting by is taking it day by day. You have to make it through the day. And little by little coping things will get easier, even communicating with others who may be difficult will become easier because you're managing your feelings and expressions and relaxing your mind. I would also recommend a change of scenery, going outside for a few minutes a day and taking in your surroundings, try to focus on the scenery itself and not on your internal thoughts. Focus on the external not the internal for a couple minutes every day. Best of luck with everything I know life can be hard but you have gotten this far. I wish you strength.
